sources.panel.py:
from typing import TypedDict
from quantize import nearest

class Reading(TypedDict):
    station: str
    degrees: int

def rounded(sample: Reading) -> list:
    return [sample, nearest(sample["degrees"])]
sources.panel.tide:
use quantize

record Reading
station:t degrees:i

rounded sample:{Reading} > &{Reading}i
pair sample (nearest (get degrees sample))

example below_half rounded
{"inputs":{"sample":{"station":"Nord","degrees":24}},"expect":[{"station":"Nord","degrees":24},2]}

example negative_half rounded
{"inputs":{"sample":{"station":"Nord","degrees":-25}},"expect":[{"station":"Nord","degrees":-25},-2]}
sources.quantize.tide:
nearest value:i > i
let base div value 10
let rest mod value 10
let magnitude if (< rest 0) (- 0 rest) rest
if (< magnitude 5) base
let step if (< value 0) -1 1
if (> magnitude 5) (+ base step) (on_half base step)

on_half base:i step:i > i
if (eq (mod base 2) 0) (+ base step) base
